description: Shared schema for the Thai E-Commerce Multi-Agent thesis evaluation dataset
researcher: XINGYUCHEN (2505310001) — Stamford International University, M.Sc. DIT

scenario_id.description: Unique sequential identifier per scenario group

category.description: Which agent or subsystem this scenario evaluates

subcategory.description: Optional finer-grained grouping within the category

language.description: Language of the user message: Thai only, Thai-English mixed, or English

input_type.description: How typical the input is: normal = well-formed query, boundary = edge case / minimal / casual, abnormal = missing info / ambiguous / out-of-scope / gibberish

user_message.description: The raw customer message as it would be typed in the chat UI

expected_intent.description: The intent constant the router should return (must match app.agents.router exactly)

expected_agent.description: The target_agent the router should dispatch to

expected_entities.description: Entities the router should extract from the message (e.g. order_id)

requires_clarification.description: Whether the router should flag this message as needing clarification

simulated_human_review.description: Whether the router should flag this message for human review (OUT_OF_SCOPE)

expected_answer_facts.description: Specific facts the downstream agent's answer should contain. May be empty for routing-only tests.

notes.description: Optional context about what this scenario tests
